lists.content:
• 3+ years of customer relationship or account management experience working in software as a service (SaaS)
  • Solutions and results-oriented mindset
  • Experienced in customer-facing roles, including analyzing customer accounts, identifying churn signals and account growth opportunities
  • Highly organized with strong project management and time management skills
  • Hands-on experience with product training to external customers
  • Proven experience delivering value-based communications
  • Strong ability to facilitate meetings with customers and users of various levels of seniority
  • Empathy for customers
  • Experience with opportunity identification for account expansion and revenue growth
  • Passion and drive to work in a quickly growing startup where you will help shape a new function and the ways we add value with our customers

lists.content:
• Perform comprehensive dental examinations, evaluations, and treatment planning.
  • Diagnose oral health conditions and develop individualized treatment plans.
  • Provide general dentistry services, including fillings, crowns, bridges, extractions, and other restorative procedures.
  • Review and interpret dental X-rays and other diagnostic imaging.
  • Administer local anesthesia as appropriate.
  • Perform routine and complex restorative dental procedures.
  • Educate patients on oral hygiene, preventive care, and treatment options.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed patient records in accordance with clinical and regulatory standards.
  • Clearly explain diagnoses, treatment recommendations, risks, benefits, and alternatives to patients.
  • Monitor patient progress and provide appropriate follow-up care.
  • Collaborate with Dental Assistants and Hygienists to ensure efficient patient flow and quality care.
  • Maintain strict infection-control, OSHA, HIPAA, and safety standards.
  • Stay current with developments in dentistry, technology, materials, and treatment techniques.
  • Participate in continuing education and professional development.
  • Build trust and positive relationships with patients and families.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, professional, and positive office culture.
